say:9:1310814008:0.text: Can you tell what really happened back then?

say:10:1310814009:0.text: In the time that you have spent in Whiteridge, you must've encountered numerous tales concerning the First Divine War, have you not?
say:10:1310814009:0.source_cn: 你们来到白山这些天，应该没少听到关于第一次神魔战争的传说吧？

say:11:1310814010:0.text: Yes! The festival commemorating the war heroes, the special sapphirine blossom, the relics of the past… We learned of many things related to the war.
say:11:1310814010:0.source_cn: 嗯！纪念战争英雄的祭典，七瓣蓝绒花、花海里的遗迹和战士...

say:12:1310814011:1.text: Indeed, the war was so merciless that it was etched into the very blood of the people, a memory they dared not let fade.
say:12:1310814011:1.source_cn: 是啊……那场战争太惨烈了，惨烈到人们不得不将它刻印在血...

say:13:1310814012:0.source_cn: 那时候，除了走不动路的老人和年幼孩童，这里几乎所有的人...

say:14:1310814013:0.source_cn: 但我们还是无法抵抗恶魔的进攻，尤其是它们的首领——我们...

say:17:1310814015:0.text: Indeed, the Lord of Death himself... He stood before us and presented us with a choice. We chose to become Graveborn and continue the fight.

say:18:1310814017:1.source_cn: 可是，为什么现在你的神智还很清晰，但那些活死人……你的...

say:19:1310814018:1.text: After the war ended, the people slowly forgot the savagery it had wrought. Through the generations, peace returned to the land. However, our memories remain fresh. We have carried these wounds for two thousand years.
say:19:1310814018:1.source_cn: 战争结束了，人们一代代传承，总会慢慢遗忘伤痛，归于平静...

say:20:1310814019:0.text: The flames of war burn in our hearts and torture our souls unceasingly. Eternal pain is the price for eternal life.
say:20:1310814019:0.source_cn: 战火毫不停息地灼烧着我们的内心，折磨着我们的灵魂——永...

say:21:1310814020:0.text: My companions were never afraid of the Hypogeans, but they could not resist the pain throughout the millennia. They were devoured by anguish and torment, lost themselves, became the undead you see before you.
say:21:1310814020:0.source_cn: 我的战友们……他们无惧恶魔的威胁，却无法抵抗这样的痛苦...

say:22:1310814021:0.text: The people remain utterly ignorant of what happened and regard us as minions of the Hypogeans. I harbor no resentment toward them, yet I cannot help but feel a sense of helplessness and betrayal.
say:22:1310814021:0.source_cn: 人们对这一切毫不知情，将我们视作恶魔的眷属、邪恶的化身...

say:24:1310814023:0.text: ... Let us make our way to the center of the battlefield.
say:24:1310814023:0.source_cn: ……来吧，我带你们去战场中心看看。
